title: Eski dost

characters.MAN: a man of about thirty-five with short brown hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a dark blue coat and a grey scarf
characters.FRIEND: his old friend, a man of about thirty-five with curly black hair and round glasses, wearing a brown corduroy jacket

scenes.text:
Bazı dostlar yıllarca aramaz,
sen de aramazsın.
scenes.prompt: On an autumn evening, {MAN} sits at his desk by a window and looks at an old photograph of two smiling boys on bicycles, fallen leaves outside.

scenes.text:
Hayat araya girer:
işler, şehirler, yorgunluk.
scenes.prompt: {MAN} walks quickly on a busy autumn street with a briefcase, tired face, golden leaves blowing around, soft evening light.

scenes.text: Sonra bir gün bir köşe başında karşılaşırsınız.
scenes.prompt: On a street corner under an autumn tree, {MAN} on the left and {FRIEND} on the right suddenly stop and stare at each other in surprise, leaves falling.

scenes.text: Ve sanki dün ayrılmışsınız gibi gülersiniz.
scenes.prompt: {MAN} and {FRIEND} hug and laugh warmly on the street corner under the golden autumn tree, patting each other's backs.

scenes.text: Gerçek dostluk, aradaki yılları hiç saymaz.
scenes.prompt: In a cozy café by the window, {MAN} on the left and {FRIEND} on the right drink tea and laugh together, rain softly falling outside, warm lights.

caption:
Yıllar geçse de bazı dostluklar hiç eskimez. Aklına ilk kim geldi? 🤍

Ona gönder, belki bugün ararsınız.
